row_labels: 1.—Continuing the Amoy Road in an easterly direction to join the Fuhkien Road.

4.—Widening Ningpo Road to 30 feet, between Shansi and Fuhkien Roads.
5.—Extension of Shantung Road, from Nanking to Ningpo Road.
6.—Extension of Woo-foo-loong, from Soochow Creek to Nanking Road.
7.—To continue in a northerly direction to Seward Road, the Taiping and Keecheong Roads and proposed road midway and parallel to the Hwakee and Chaou-foong Roads (Pan-joe-loong alley).
9.—Hanbury Road extension from Sin-kei-pang to Dent Road.
